The '''Ku'Bakai system''', also known as the '''Kubindi system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Ku'Bakai 6]], [[Ku'Bakai 8]], [[Ku'Bakai 11]], and the primary star [[Ku'Bakai]]. The Kubaz colonized several habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the Ku'Bakai system.
